required_coverage: Score each predeclared required element as 0 or 1. Contradictory values score 0. Conditions already explicit in the question are shared. Do not infer missing conditions not in the question.
numeric_policy: Allow source units and printed source conversions. Otherwise use the fixed conversion factors and round to the decimal precision explicitly used in the answer. No extra engineering tolerances.
claims: Extract atomic factual claims once from question and evaluation answer only. Preserve negation, units, subject, constraints, and procedure order; remove duplicate claims. Reuse the same claims for actual-context and oracle support judgments.
oracle_support: A claim is supported only if the frozen oracle evidence supports it. Unsupported by the oracle is not equivalent to false in the world.
faithfulness: Judge the same claims against the actual Top-5 context. Apply to answerable RAG answers only.
unanswerable: Some facts may be answerable. Require explicit abstention for the frozen missing information; later invented specifics invalidate that abstention. LLM Only corpus-unanswerable abstention is not a real-world factual accuracy score.

answer_relevancy.rule: Use raw mean of 3 cosine similarities unless all three noncommittal flags are 1, then 0. Validate 3 nonempty reconstructed questions and flags. Do not clamp cosine scores.

missing_evaluation_policy: Retry same evaluator input at most twice, retaining all attempts; first valid result wins. Unresolved evaluator failure is missing, never a model error zero.
manual_review: PCG64(seed42): 4 single + 6 multi questions, both first-round answers; plus all 10 unanswerable, both answers. 40 answers total. Hide condition and automatic scores. Do not mix manual scores into automatic means.
final_release: Researcher source review and evaluator validation must be completed before final quality claims. Stored generation results remain usable for subsequent scoring under the declared rules. Any later evaluator choice or rubric revision is versioned and reported.
